title: Woman Descending Decayed Stairs
description: A woman in a dark jacket and light skirt walks down a dilapidated wooden staircase while carrying a glowing green CRT television in a shopping basket. The decaying building features peeling paint, exposed plaster, scattered old monitors, film reels, and a large faded mural of a drive-in theater on the lower wall.
prompt: A woman with short dark hair wearing a dark jacket and light skirt carries a glowing retro CRT television inside a shopping basket as she descends a worn wooden staircase inside a dilapidated building.
